mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mer_application(application_id,applicant_user_id,request_key,merchant_name,category,contact_name,contact_phone,store_name,campus_location,status) VALUES(#{po.applicationId},#{po.applicantUserId},#{po.requestKey},#{po.merchantName},#{po.category},#{po.contactName},#{po.contactPhone},#{po.storeName},#{po.campusLocation},#{po.status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE application_id=application_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mer_application WHERE applicant_user_id=#{applicantUserId} AND request_key=#{requestKey}
SELECT * FROM mer_application WHERE application_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mer_application SET status=#{po.status},reviewer_user_id=#{po.reviewerUserId},rejection_reason=#{po.rejectionReason},opened_merchant_id=#{po.openedMerchantId},version=version+1 WHERE application_id=#{po.applicationId} AND version=#{po.version} AND status='SUBMITTED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mer_application WHERE 1=1 AND applicant_user_id=#{userId}AND status=#{status} AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ',application_id,merchant_name,contact_name,store_name,contact_phone)))>0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, application_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mer_application WHERE 1=1 AND applicant_user_id=#{userId}AND status=#{status} AND LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ',application_id,merchant_name,contact_name,store_name,contact_phone)))>0
